subject: Draft: MAP worksheet + 15-day evaluation sprint (Strata AI)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Erik Johnson <erik.johnson@strata.ai>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@strata.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: MAP worksheet + 15-day evaluation sprint (Strata AI)

Hi Erik / Sana —

Thanks again for the session last week. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) worksheet + a 15-day evaluation sprint timeline to help structure the pilot and make responsibilities visible. The doc is a collaborative Google Doc (link below) — feel free to co-edit.

High-level ask: can we confirm owners and acceptance criteria by EOD Friday so we can lock the environment and schedule the infra kickoff?

What’s in the doc:
- Week-by-week milestones (environment, test data, POC runbook, acceptance checklist)
- Roles/owners column for each milestone (Redwood owner / Strata owner)
- Acceptance criteria and success metrics (latency, stability, accuracy on sample prompts)
- Procurement & security touchpoints (placeholder rows)

Proposed next steps:
1) Co-edit MAP worksheet (link) — add procurement/security contacts and any missing success metrics
2) 30-min kickoff to confirm scope and owners (suggest Tue 11/10 10:00–10:30 PT)
3) Lock pilot environment by 11/15 so we can start the 15-day run on 11/16

Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFG-map-worksheet-v1
Attached: 15d-pilot-timeline.xlsx (workload milestones + checkpoints)

If that timeline looks tight, we can push the start a week, but the team recommended a 15-day run to get early signal on latency/cost and iterate quickly.

Thanks — I’ll keep this thread for MAP edits and move procurement/security to a separate thread once we have contacts.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.inference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: MAP worksheet + 15-day evaluation sprint (Strata AI)

On Mon, Nov 8, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Erik / Sana —
>
> Thanks again for the session last week. Per our conversation I put together a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) worksheet + a 15-day evaluation sprint timeline to help structure the pilot and make responsibilities visible. The doc is a collaborative Google Doc (link below) — feel free to co-edit.

Thanks Jasmine — nice structure. I skimmed the doc and added a couple of rows / comments:
- Add an explicit data access milestone (week 0) so Strata gives team a sanitized dataset and we confirm PII removal.
- Add acceptance criteria for cost-per-inference (target: < $0.01/token for the 3k context batch tests) and 95th percentile latency target (<= 200ms).
- Add a POC runbook task: "test KV cache + cold start" and owner = Redwood Infra (Ben).

I attached a compact timeline that collapses the week 2 demo into a single "sprint review" and requests a short executive check-in after the pilot.

Ben — can you confirm infra owner for the KV caching test and whether the 95th pctl target is realistic on our default config?

Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: 15d-pilot-timeline.xlsx

From: Erik Johnson <erik.johnson@strata.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@strata.ai>, procurement@strata.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: MAP worksheet + 15-day evaluation sprint (Strata AI)

Jasmine / Marissa —

This looks good and aligned with our goals. A few asks from the Strata side:
- Please add a security milestone in week 0 for the questionnaire and initial SOC2 artifact share. Our security lead (cc'd procurement for awareness) needs to see the SLA and data handling row before we sign off the environment.
- Add a procurement touchpoint column that includes our PO cadence and contact (I looped procurement).
- Can we move the kickoff to Tue 11/10 10:30 PT instead of 10:00 PT? I have a stand overlap.

If you add the two rows above I can ask our infra lead to own the data prep and we’ll confirm the sanitized dataset delivery by 11/12. Also happy to co-edit the doc — I added a comment about the acceptance metric for hallucination rate on the top-10 prompt set.

Erik Johnson
Head of ML Ops | Strata AI
erik.johnson@strata.ai

- Week 1 (11/16–11/20): infra validation, cold-start + KV cache tests (Redwood owner: Ben), integration smoke tests
